title: Word Wizard word list
description: A pupil's English word list with progress, exported from Word Wizard and importable into another session.

version.description: Format version. Files with a higher version need a newer Word Wizard.

exportedAt.description: When the file was exported (ISO 8601, UTC).

app.description: Name and version of the app that wrote the file.

homeLanguage.description: The translation language selected when the file was exported.

stats.description: Summary for humans. Ignored on import.

languageCode.description: BCP 47 language code, for example "he" or "pt-BR".

text.description: The English word or short phrase, lowercase.

learned.description: The pupil marked it with a star.

mastered.description: The pupil passed the Word Challenge for it.

source.description: How the word was first added.

senses.description: Optional. A word with more than one meaning ("light" = bright / not heavy). Each meaning has its own translation, hint, memory pair and example.

hint.description: Emoji and a very simple English hint.

sense.description: Optional. Which of the senses the pupil picked (index). Missing: not picked yet, all are shown.

sayItLike.description: No longer used. Old files may still have it; it is ignored on import.

example.description: A simple example sentence that uses the word.

exampleTranslations.description: Translations of the example sentence by language code.

pair.description: Memory pair: an easy everyday phrase with the word, for example "return home".

pairTranslations.description: Translations of the memory pair by language code.
